definitions.explanation: A sharp, high-pitched cry uttered out of fear, pain, or shock. Also used figuratively to describe an extreme state of distress or strain.

examples.japanese: {悲鳴|ひめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悲鳴|ひめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
⟦{人手|ひとで}{不足|ぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悲鳴|ひめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げている→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The workplace is crying out from the lack of staff.
examples.notes: Figurative use: a situation in extreme strain.

notes:
{悲鳴|ひめい} combines {悲|ひ} (sad, tragic) and {鳴|めい} (cry, sound).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲鳴|ひめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to let out a scream
- {悲鳴|ひめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: a scream echoes
- {悲鳴|ひめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: a scream is heard

USAGE:
{悲鳴|ひめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ is commonly used figuratively to mean "to be under extreme strain":
- ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悲鳴|ひめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げている→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: household finances are groaning
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悲鳴|ひめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: one's body is crying out (from overwork or exhaustion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悲鳴|ひめい}: scream of fear or distress
- {叫|さけ}び: shout, cry (broader, not limited to distress)
- ⟦{絶叫|ぜっきょう}→絶叫：13810_zekkyou⟧: shriek, piercing scream (more intense)
